title: Implement finite-handle QQ16 context restoration with bounded record reuse
body:
PR5330 leaves Context/Program creation outside its finite source-handle frontend. This adds an executable inventory-metadata constructor for the literal `Machine.restore_context`, preserving ordered fields, shared `raw`, fixed highs/program Tape aliases, and retained old objects.

Under an explicit fixed-boundary contract and at most one held prior Context/Program pair, **15 dynamic records suffice for arbitrarily many restorations**. The package derives that transient capacity and a complete padded-scan charge for this metadata operation. It adds only `research/qq16-context-restore/`.

### Scope and coordination

- Base/current-main checkpoint: `7c472563474e60185e6ca101a17622133d047e56`, priority revision 7.
- Takes a bounded part of [the released lifecycle handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/4744#discussioncomment-19151254) and PR5330 Open next question 1; [advance claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/4744#discussioncomment-19152880).
- Final overlap refresh: 307 open PR bodies, 4,638 Discussion records, all 7,267 tracked top-level notes, complete reported pagination. The [concurrent numerical producer investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/4744#discussioncomment-19152915) explicitly released restoration overlap and now covers `new_context` scratch/installation. Its results are not assumed here.
- [Proof and exact boundary](https://github.com/mihir-s-05/integer-mult-bounds/blob/a9e5ab880bc006aa9366fc1d037ba4ad86132dd8/research/qq16-context-restore/PROOF.md); [deterministic receipt](https://github.com/mihir-s-05/integer-mult-bounds/blob/a9e5ab880bc006aa9366fc1d037ba4ad86132dd8/research/qq16-context-restore/RESULT.json).

### Evidence

On Windows / CPython 3.12.0, the registered normal and optimized replays pass:

```sh
python -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/qq16-context-restore --check-only
python -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/qq16-context-restore
python -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/qq16-context-restore
```

The oracle executes unchanged selected method/class ASTs, the actual Count inheritance chain and the retained inventory function. Four sessions cover **864 restorations**, all 108 slot tuples twice per session, plain and cyclic/shared boundaries, 16-bit and 4,096-bit source buffers, ten rejecting controls, and complete owned metadata disposal. A held old pair survives 108 later restorations. Borrowed contents, heads, meters and live sets remain unchanged. These are structural fixtures; not every tuple is a valid numerical parent frame.

All 13 package/input files pass committed-byte comparison. The official export passes integrity checking and normal/optimized direct replay with Git absent from PATH. The optional full-history preflight reports that full Git history is required in this shallow checkout; base ancestry and the exact committed source bytes were checked separately.

### Remaining limits

This is a partial source-frontend result: no numerical `new_context`/`high_count`, serialized-header decoding, whole-caller alias closure, initial boundary compiler, physical parking, full F(K)/D* versus B* bill, or supplier admission. The one-held-pair condition is explicit, not asserted for every caller. No selected cold replay, full controller, Lean, Docker, new kappa or multiplication-theorem claim. The selected frontier and all frozen inputs are unchanged.

Credit JoyboyBrian's PR4986/5034/5330, Chris R/Clear1nsight, Jose Manuel, Tekalign, Mihir Srivastava, ywz65 and the retained archive notices. Prepared for Mihir Srivastava (@mihir-s-05) with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0. Author-checked; no independent human or proof-kernel acceptance.
